thread:
alex_fin: Heads up 021: Invoice INV-9077 (Acct: OASIS-21) failed auto-collect at 08:07 UTC. Amount 5,125.50 USD. Stripe decline: `authentication_required` + issuer returned `challenge_failed`. Customer says cardholder attempted OTP but bank page errored.

payments-bot: Automated event: payment.failed invoice=INV-9077 amount=5125.50 provider=stripe decline_code=authentication_required

ryan_support: Ticket #12988. Customer asked if they can split payment across two cards or pay via wire. They're in PK and treasury prefers wire but need our bank details + invoice copy.

alex_fin: Splits are messy for our AR but possible if we create two invoices or accept a card + wire split. Need ops + legal signoff for wire since amount > $5k when converted to PKR and cross-border wire adds AML paperwork.

tamara_ops: I can greenlight a one-off wire if AML team approves the counterparty and we get a signed invoice acceptance. Looping in @legal. Also note: our finance bank requires beneficiary name exact match; ask customer to confirm. Wires take 2+ business days.

legal: We'll need the invoice acceptance clause signed. I can approve standard clause. Send copy to contracts@redwood and I'll fast-track.

payments-bot: Suggestion: create Checkout session that forces 3DS and allows customer to attempt card again. Recommend parameter: `payment_method_options[card][request_three_d_secure]=any` so banks are prompted. Also set `expires_at` to 24h.

alex_fin: If customer prefers split card payment, we can: 1) create two new invoices (e.g., INV-9077-A and INV-9077-B) for the partial amounts, OR 2) accept a card charge + manual wire for remainder. Prefer 1) for clean reconciliation. Would need support to generate adjusted invoices.

ryan_support: They asked for guidance text for the merchant portal link and wire fallback. Drafted short message: ```
Hi OASIS team,

Our attempted card authorization failed because your bank requires a 3D Secure verification that didn't complete. Options:
- Try this secure payment link (expires in 24h) and complete the bank verification.
- Provide an alternate card.
- Request wire instructions and we will issue a split invoice if you want to pay part by wire. Wires can take 2-3 business days and require beneficiary name + company registration number.

Reply which option you prefer and we'll send the next steps.
```

tamara_ops: Create the Checkout link and the two partial invoices in the system if they pick split. Also flag AML review for PK counterparty.

alex_fin: I'll do the split invoices if they confirm amounts. For reference, example Checkout API curl to force 3DS: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.stripe.com/v1/checkout/sessions \
  -u sk_live_xxx: \
  -d payment_method_types[]=card \
  -d line_items[0][price_data][currency]=usd \
  -d line_items[0][price_data][unit_amount]=512550 \
  -d payment_method_options[card][request_three_d_secure]=any \
  -d success_url=\"https://app.redwood.example/pay/success\" \
  -d cancel_url=\"https://app.redwood.example/pay/cancel\"\n```

payments-bot: Note: splitting invoices will create two invoice numbers and require manual reconciliation in QuickBooks. Tagging accounting for tracking.

ryan_support: Customer replied: \"We want to split: charge 2,500 USD to credit card now and wire the rest. Send link + wire details.\"

tamara_ops: Approving wire fallback pending AML review and legal signature. Alex, proceed to create INV-9077-A (2,500.00) and INV-9077-B (2,625.50) and generate the checkout link for the 2,500 invoice. I will trigger AML check and loop legal for the signature.

alex_fin: Created invoices INV-9077-A and INV-9077-B and Checkout link for INV-9077-A: https://pay.redwood.example/checkout/s/split987 (expires 24h). Metadata: invoice=INV-9077-A.

payments-bot: Automated event: payment.succeeded invoice=INV-9077-A amount=2500 provider=stripe charge=ch_4AbcSuccess

ryan_support: Sent wire instructions and invoice copy to customer. They confirmed wire initiated. Customer says bank gave a reference: REF-WIRE-331.

tamara_ops: AML cleared on counterparty. Legal confirmed signed clause received via contracts@redwood. Approving manual receipt of wire. Please mark INV-9077-B pending and reconcile once bank posts.

alex_fin: Marked INV-9077 as partially paid (2,500.00). Keeping INV-9077-B open until wire posts. Noting ref REF-WIRE-331 on the invoice for reconciliation. Closing thread once bank confirms. :white_check_mark:
